title: Company
description: Comprehensive business entity information including corporate details, financial metrics, organizational structure, and contact information. Used for company profiles, directories, and business intelligence.

id.description: Unique identifier for the company record

name.description: Official legal name of the company

slogan.description: Company tagline or marketing slogan that represents the brand

description.description: Detailed description of the company's business, mission, products, and services

industry.description: Primary industry sector the company operates in (e.g., Software, Manufacturing, Retail)

size.description: Company size classification based on employee count (e.g., startup, small, medium, large, enterprise)

founded_year.description: Year the company was established or incorporated

headquarters.description: City where the company's main headquarters or corporate office is located

country.description: Country where the company is headquartered or primarily operates

email.description: Primary corporate email address for general inquiries

phone.description: Main corporate phone number for business inquiries

revenue.description: Annual revenue or total sales figure, typically in the company's primary currency

employees.description: Total number of employees working for the company worldwide

logo.description: URL to the company's official logo image
